title: 卢锡安·窗边绿植
description: 深肤短发卢锡安穿完整长外套，在窗边擦一片小绿叶，双枪收在封闭枪套里。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Lucian is a dark-skinned adult man with short textured hair, a neatly shaped beard, focused eyes, and a long dark coat with white and gold Sentinel accents. Preserve his strong upright silhouette through a fully covering shirt, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots. His two distinctive relic pistols remain safely in closed side holsters, never drawn, aimed, or glowing.
art_direction.scene: He stands beside a quiet window and wipes a broad leaf of a little potted plant with a folded cloth, concentrating with a gentle half-smile. A small watering cup and one empty stool complete the room. Keep both hands on the ordinary plant-care task, with the holsters closed and no spectral enemies or combat effects.
art_direction.palette: charcoal coat, warm brown, ivory trim, fresh green
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
